source.publication: Publication 120 Retirement Income (December 2025), with the 2025 IL-1040 Instructions and Form IL-1040
source.section: Pub 120 PDF page 2 'What retirement income may I subtract', PDF page 3 'What federally taxed income may I not subtract'; Form IL-1040 Line 5; Instructions PDF page 7, Line 5; Form IL-1040 PDF page 1, Lines 1-19; Instructions PDF page 8, Lines 10-12; rate Instructions PDF page 1; Line 10a chart and Income Exceptions, Instructions PDF page 8

worked: Federal AGI = wages (person 0) 42,850.00 + military pension (person 0) 30,000.00 = 72,850.00. Federal taxable income = 72,850.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 57,100.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; federal figures are given, not tested; Illinois starts from federal AGI). Form IL-1040 Line 1 federal AGI 72,850.00. Line 2 federally tax-exempt interest 0.00. Line 3 other additions 0.00. Line 4 = 72,850.00. Line 5 military pension 30,000.00 = 30,000.00. Lines 6 and 7 0.00. Line 8 = 30,000.00. Line 9 base income = 72,850.00 - 30,000.00 = 42,850.00. Income Exceptions: federal AGI 72,850.00 is not greater than 250,000.00, so the allowance stands. Line 10a 2,850.00. Line 10b 0.00. Lines 10c and 10d 0.00. Line 10 = 2,850.00. Line 11 net income = 42,850.00 - 2,850.00 = 40,000.00. Line 12 tax = 40,000.00 x 4.95% = 1,980.0000. Lines 13-18 0.00 (no credits in the projection). Line 19 state income tax = 1,980.00. No age test: the filer is 45.
